text:
ajay: Heads-up — seeing a p95 token-latency spike in eu-west-1 over the last 30m. TTFT also jumped from ~20ms to ~180ms for several routes. Grafana panels show tokens/sec drop on a few pools. Anyone digging in? /cc @cheng @olivia :wave:
cheng: I saw the alert from sre-bot. Prometheus shows sustained queue depth increase on runtime-group-small-eu for ~25m. Looks like batch latency growing. Grafana link: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/token-slo?orgId=1 (open) :mag:
olivia: Checked envoy logs for frontdoor-egress, a handful of 502s but error rate ~0.15% — unlikely to explain the whole p95 shift. No obvious network flaps in cloud provider status. :thinking:
nate: kube events show node pressure (memory) and a couple of OOMKills on sidecar proxy in that nodepool. Node autoscaler did not kick — min nodes already hit for that pool. Suggest temporarily increase pool to +2 to relieve pressure. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ajay: Agreed. Before we scale, can we get a token-level drilldown? Need to know whether a specific model or route is sending long-context requests. PromQL I used: 
```
sum(rate(redwood_runtime_tokens_total{region="eu-west-1"}[1m])) by (model)
```
Shows one model spiking; model: small-gpt-6b-quantized.
cheng: Also look at latency histogram: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_token_latency_seconds_bucket{region="eu-west-1"}[5m])) by (le, route))
```
That gives per-route p95 token latency. Route /v1/chat/generate is the top offender.
olivia: From logs, requests hitting that route have median prompt length ~2200 tokens; TTFT rise correlates with long-prefix KV cache warmups — cache miss ratio is higher for that model after a deploy yesterday. Possibly quantization kernels have slower first-call latency.
ajay: So root causes seem multi-factor: node memory pressure + cache miss pattern on that model + batch sizes shrinking (tokens/sec down). Propose actions: 1) scale pool +2 now, 2) pin older kernel (rollback) for small-gpt-6b on eu-west-1 canary variant, 3) add a Grafana drilldown dashboard tile that shows p50/p95/p99 + TTFT + tokens/sec by (region, model, route) with a heatmap and quick filter for "cache_miss=true".
cheng: For alerts, current rule fires on p95 > 250ms for 5m. It's noisy during bursty deploys. Suggest changing to: p95 > 300ms AND tokens/sec < 0.5 * baseline for 10m OR p99 > 600ms for 5m. That reduces false positives while keeping severity.
nate: I'll scale the pool now (nodepool-gpu-eu-1 -> +2). Also enabling eviction-logging and adding a kube event alert for OOMKills so we get faster context next time.
sre-bot: Scaling action: requested scale up of nodepool-gpu-eu-1 by +2 (initiated). ETA ~3m.
grafana-bot: New dashboard panel suggestion: "Token SLO Drilldown" created in drafts for review — includes p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/sec, cache_miss filter. Sharing draft: https://grafana.internal/draft/xyz789
ajay: Thanks. After scale completes let's re-evaluate p95 and TTFT over the next 15m. If still high, we'll rollback kernel and open a quick incident runbook. Also please capture a perf profile of the quantized kernel on a test node.
olivia: capturing logs and enabling extra KV cache metrics now. Will post short summary in 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
cheng: I'll update the alert rule PR and add runbook steps for "token latency spike" with drilldown queries.
ajay: Great teamwork. Keeping this thread for the follow-ups. If anyone sees the p99 shoot up, ping #incidents as well. :thumbsup:
